text: Branch policy change from the owner (2026-10-01): main and v1-development must always be identical and development now happens on main. main was fast-forwarded to v1-development (fa527a2b2); from now on branch from origin/main and open PRs with --base main. After each merge Claude fast-forwards v1-development to main's tip (owner bypass, no force, no merge commit). Also: PR for operator/type strictness (#5940, #6141, expression part of #5939) incoming against main; it makes + - * / ^ comparisons AND OR NOT unary-minus IIF ICASE and BETWEEN raise VFP9's errors (107/9/11) for mismatched types. Three existing test scripts incremented an uninitialized PUBLIC variable (.F. + 1, error 107 in VFP9) and now initialize it.
